description: Return, per stock ticker, the Hyperliquid HIP-3 perp mark and oracle, the reference stock price and the Solana xStock price, with every pairwise gap in basis points and funding Gap table for Hyperliquid HIP-3 stock perps (trade.xyz) crossed with the Solana xStock of the same company: perp mark vs oracle, perp vs reference stock price, perp vs xStock and xStock vs reference, in basis points, plus hourly and annualized funding, 24h volume and open interest. Top markets by volume or your tickers. Query: ?tickers=TSLA,NVDA or ?limit= — $0.005000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "hyperliquid stock perp basis", "trade.xyz perp vs xstock gap", "tokenized stock arbitrage table".
name: perps_stock-gaps
